gaGateJob.yamlQuote:
ga-gate:
    name: GA-gate (contract gates, shrink-only ratchet)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    # GA-GATE-RATCHET (L-775) -- MERGE-BLOCKING. `continue-on-error: true` is GONE.
      - name: Contract gates (ratcheted -- count printed by run-all.ts)
        run: pnpm run ga-gate:all
      - name: Legacy release gate (advisory)
        continue-on-error: true
        run: pnpm run ga-gate
gaGateJob.note: The JOB has no continue-on-error. The SECOND STEP inside it is advisory: pnpm run ga-gate resolves to node packages/release/src/ga-gate.mjs (package.json:52), a different and smaller script. pnpm run ga-gate:all resolves to tsx tools/ga-gate/run-all.ts (package.json:57).
